# laravelforge_worker (Resource)

Manages a worker (server background process) on a Laravel Forge server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `command` (String) Command the worker runs.
- `name` (String) Name of the worker. Required on create; updatable.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `processes` (Number) Number of processes the worker runs.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server to create the worker on.
- `user` (String) System user the worker runs as.

### Optional

- `directory` (String) Working directory of the worker.
- `site_id` (Number) Optional ID of the site to associate the worker with. Create-only.
- `startsecs` (Number) Seconds the process must stay up to be considered started. Create-only.
- `stopsignal` (String) Signal used to stop the process (e.g. `SIGTERM`). Create-only.
- `stopwaitsecs` (Number) Seconds to wait for a graceful stop before killing the process. Create-only.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the worker (background process).
- `status` (String) Provisioning status.
